question: State the main properties of photons used to explain the photoelectric effect.

options.A: A photon has energy $E=I\nu$, non-zero rest mass and no momentum; it transfers energy to many electrons at once.
options.B: A photon has energy $E=h\nu$, momentum $p=\dfrac{h\nu}{c}=\dfrac{h}{\lambda}$, zero rest mass, and travels with speed $c$ in vacuum. In photoelectric emission, one photon transfers energy to one electron.
options.C: A photon has energy independent of frequency, zero momentum and travels slower than light in vacuum.
options.D: A photon has mass $m=\dfrac{h\nu}{c^2}$ at rest and transfers energy only after accumulating with other photons.
